scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Classify facts and reconcile the whole source population
cases.input_contract: Add reason using missing fact identity, negative known amount, then accepted precedence. Retain all source records;acceptedNULL amounts remain unknown.
cases.expected: Accepted 2000, rejected 2 with source 2001 missing_identity and 2002 negative_amount. Accepted unique fact IDs 2000 and known amounts 1800.
cases.verification: Assert every rejection identity/reason, source reconciliation and accepted uniqueness/completeness counts.

cases.title: Select an approved unique dimension before tuning
cases.input_contract: Keep approved dimension rows, require at most 100 rows and known unique keys, then return key, factor. Reject a candidate with a second approved key 0 row.
cases.expected: Reviewed keys 0..5, factors 2..7, six rows. The conflicting approved candidate fails before joining.
cases.verification: Assert all six key/factor rows and the explicit duplicate-approved rejection.

cases.title: Produce the correct baseline and independent key summary
cases.input_contract: Build the ordinary equality join over accepted facts and reviewed dimension, projecting source_id, fact_id, key, amount, factor. Summarize per key with rows, known amounts, total amount and weighted total.
cases.verification: Assert all five summary tuples and aggregate metrics 2000,2000,1800,7196,17913.

cases.title: Compare a bounded broadcast strategy with the same business contract
cases.input_contract: Broadcast the reviewed dimension for the same equality join and projection. Preserve all output occurrences using exceptAll in both directions against baseline.
cases.expected: Identical metrics and empty directional bag differences. The candidate plan containsBroadcastHashJoin.
cases.verification: Assert the full metric map, both distributed bag differences and the observed strategy marker.

cases.title: Assemble an honest bounded comparison receipt
cases.input_contract: Return version, master, AQE and automatic broadcast threshold as named fields. Attach key frequencies, the baseline/candidate plans and each observed summary-query exchange metric map.
cases.expected: Spark 4.0.1, local[2], AQEfalse, threshold-1;key 0 frequency 1600 and others 100. Both runs expose actual nonempty exchange observations. No peak-memory or throughput value is invented.
cases.verification: Assert controlled settings and frequency ledger, then print plans and separately labeled actual metric maps.

cases.title: Roll back execution policy without rolling back data quality
cases.input_contract: Choose baseline or broadcast using an explicit Boolean switch over the same accepted facts and reviewed dimension. Switch back to baseline and revalidate the complete product.
cases.expected: Both switch positions satisfy the same metric map and bag contract. The disabled position has noBroadcastHashJoin under the controlled configuration.
cases.verification: Assert golden metrics and bag equality after rollback, and inspect the restored baseline plan.
